Add spring discount codes to the order book

SPRING10 takes 10 % off an order's items, rounded half up to the cent;
WELCOME5 takes 5.00 € off items of 30.00 € or more. An order takes one
code at most, and applyCode(orderNumber, code) replaces it. A refused
code leaves the order as it was. Shipping is still decided on the items
before the discount.

OrderTotals gains discountCents; totalCents is items minus discount plus
shipping.
